Character sprites extracted from Templa!! (てんぷれっ!!).

The sprites in this gallery were extracted from the Ren'Py release.

The original sprite files were stored in WebP format. They have been
losslessly converted to PNG, and unnecessary transparent/blank margins
have been cropped for easier viewing and archival.

从《てんぷれっ!!（Templa!!）》游戏资源中提取的人物立绘。

本画廊中的立绘提取自 Ren'Py 版本。

原始立绘资源以 WebP 格式保存，本合集已将其无损转换为 PNG，
并裁去图片外围不必要的透明／空白区域，以便浏览与归档。
